data.title: 春日野穹 · 海湾遮阳伞下的白色耳机
data.description: 【海边小镇湾口·傍晚】穹穿着黑白泳装蜷坐在沙滩椅上，白色耳机线绕过长发，脚边放着喝到一半的苏打水；她把一只耳机轻轻递向镜头，夕阳让冷淡的表情显出柔和。
data.location: quiet bay near the country town
data.action: 沙滩椅上蜷坐听歌，递出另一只耳机，夕阳让冷淡表情变柔和
data.promptProse: Sora Kasugano curls in a beach chair at the small town's bay mouth, offering one white earpiece toward the viewer while the other wire lies through her long hair. A light cardigan covers the black-and-white swimsuit, half-finished soda beside her feet. The horizontal medium view includes the still bay behind. Lavender sunset softens her grey-eyed expression and sleeve folds, with cool water reflections along the chair frame and can.
